name: io.github.chrischall/simplisafe-mcp
description: Check SimpliSafe system state and sensors, review events, arm/disarm, and control smart locks

environmentVariables.name: SIMPLISAFE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token from the one-time browser login (scripts/bootstrap-auth.mjs)

environmentVariables.name: SIMPLISAFE_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: SIMPLISAFE_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.simplisafe-mcp/token.json.
